sources.quote: HD 6434, also named Nenque, is a star in the southern constellation of Phoenix.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.1 solar radii and 0.98 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,777 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
